description: This file defines the SubjectsPad class, a QWidget-based GUI component for displaying and interacting with a grid of subject buttons in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It manages layout, button creation, and event handling for subject selection.

classes.name: SubjectsPad
classes.description: A QWidget subclass that creates a grid of subject buttons, handles user interactions, and emits signals for subject selection and event forwarding.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A simple QWidget containing a QPushButton, used within SubjectsPad for each subject.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Constructs the grid layout of subject buttons based on filtered subjects.

methods.name: addWidget
methods.description: Adds a subject button to the grid at specified position.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Emits the clickSignal with the selected subject.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events to forward to main window.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Emits signal to save widget geometry on close.
